Kunming

Chengjiang & Fuxian Lake day trip

Luchong fishing village, the only pink sand beach in China and a 90-minute lake cruise — the Fuxian Lake circuit out of Kunming.

Request a Call

Itinerary

  • 07:40–08:10Assemble at Yongfeng Road and board.
  • 08:10–09:30Drive to Fuhaiwan Wetland Park on Fuxian Lake — 70 km from Kunming, about 1.5 hours.
  • 09:30–10:30Flower fields along the wetland.
  • 10:30–12:00Hongshanzui and the pink sand beach — the only one of its kind in China.
  • 12:00–13:00Local lunch: copper-pot fish and potato-braised rice.
  • 13:00–14:30Luchong scenic area, a national AAAA site and a working fishing village. Climb Bijia mountain for the full lake panorama, walk Boxi bay, see the Luchong fish caves and the protected Kanglang fish.
  • 14:30–16:00Fuxian Lake by boat — the cruise is included, about 90 minutes on the water.
  • 16:00–16:40Dragon King Temple and the ancient trees, then free time on Golden Sand beach.
  • 16:40–18:10Return to Kunming, Guanshang Convention Centre. Trip ends.

Included

  • Air-conditioned coach, return
  • Lunch — copper-pot fish and potato-braised rice
  • Attraction tickets and the lake cruise
  • Licensed Mandarin-speaking guide throughout
  • Vehicles under 9 seats operate with the driver doubling as guide

Not included

  • Travel accident insurance
  • Other paid activities inside the scenic area
  • Additional costs arising from force majeure

Good to know

  • Children are charged half price for the meal and the seat.
  • If force majeure changes the itinerary or increases cost, the guest bears the cost and we assist in resolving it.
  • Bring a valid ID; children need a household register booklet.
  • Return travel falls in peak traffic and the trip may run late — plan connections accordingly.
  • The coach plate number is texted to you the evening before departure.
  • On the lake, follow crew instructions and wear a life jacket. Swimming or diving is strictly prohibited.
